business_problem: Xylem saw significant enterprise AI potential, but disconnected experiments, unclear ownership and a lack of shared governance made it hard to move from isolated initiatives to trusted, repeatable AI deployment across the business.
solution_summary: Xylem worked with EY Consulting professionals to turn enterprise AI from an experimentation program into an operating capability. Leadership first aligned on four priorities: a common AI vision, a disciplined delivery approach, a trusted technology foundation and enterprise-wide adoption. Execution centered on xylem.ai, a secure internal AI environment built in under 10 weeks by Xylem, EY and Microsoft teams. The platform brought enterprise data, AI capabilities and governance controls together in one trusted environment so new use cases could start from an approved foundation instead of being rebuilt as one-off pilots. Clear ownership was established for building, deploying and sustaining AI solutions, while role-relevant enablement helped employees apply AI in daily work. The result was a reusable platform and operating model that embedded intelligence into workflows while supporting security, compliance and responsible scale.
